cases.title: 'Out of Salad Dressing' Salad Dressing
cases.transcript: Okay, so today I'm making 'Out of Salad Dressing' Salad Dressing. For this you need 1 ½ lemons, juiced, 1 cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese, 2 teaspoons garlic salt, ¾ cup mayonnaise and 1 cup milk. First, mix together lemon juice, Parmesan cheese, garlic salt, and mayonnaise until smooth. Then, stir in milk, adjusting the amount or adding a little water, to make the dressing as thin or thick as you like. Finally, cover and refrigerate 8 hours, or overnight. And that's it.

cases.transcript: Okay, so today I'm making 1-2 Chocolate Cake. For this you need ⅓ cup (80 ml) vegetable oil, 2 ounces (55 g) unsweetened chocolate, 1 cup granulated sugar (or ½ cup), 1 egg, 1¼ cups (300 g) whole wheat flour, ½ teaspoon salt, ½ teaspoon baking soda, ½ teaspoon vanilla extract, ¾ cup (180 ml) water, ¾ cup (180 g) semi-sweet chocolate pieces (such as chocolate chips), ½ cup (120 g) chopped nuts and 4 ounces (115 g) cream cheese or sour cream (optional). First, put the oil and chocolate in an 8-inch (20 cm) square pan and set it in 350 °F (180 °C) oven just until the chocolate melts. Add sour cream or cream cheese if desired. Then, add remaining ingredients, except chocolate chips and nuts, to the pan. After that, beat with a fork until smooth and creamy (about 2 minutes). Next, scrape the sides of the pan, and spread the batter evenly in the pan. Then, sprinkle with chocolate chips and nuts. Optionally, cut the chocolate chips and nuts into the batter to some extent. After that, bake at 350 °F (180 °C) for 30 to 40 minutes, until a toothpick stuck in the center comes out clean. Finally, cool in pan; eat hot or cooled. And that's it.

cases.transcript: Okay, so today I'm making 20-Ingredient Brownies. For this you need 1½ cups (275 g / 10 oz) brown sugar, 1 cup (200 g / 7 oz) white granulated sugar, 3 sticks (375 g / 13 oz) butter, melted, 4 ea. (200 g) eggs, 2 teaspoons salt, 1 tablespoon vanilla extract, 8 oz (227 g) dark chocolate, 1½ cups (200 g / 7 oz) all-purpose flour, ½ cup (60 g / 2 oz) dutch processed cocoa powder and 8 oz (227 g) semisweet chocolate, chopped. First, preheat the oven to 180°C (356°F). Line a 33 x 23 cm (13 x 9-inch) baking pan with parchment. Then, melt dark chocolate in microwave using 30-second bursts. Leave it to cool. After that, beat the butter and sugars in a large bowl until combined. Next, beat in the eggs, salt and vanilla, then beat in the melted chocolate. Then, fold in the flour and cocoa, then the chopped chocolate. After that, pour the mixture into the lined baking pan. Finally, bake for 25 minutes. And that's it.

cases.transcript: Okay, so today I'm making 20-Minute Beef Stroganoff. For this you need 8 oz (230 g) wide egg noodles (figures are for yolk-free noodles), 1 teaspoon olive oil, 1 package (8 oz/230 g) sliced mushrooms, 1 large (1 cup/150 g/5.3 oz) coarsely-chopped onion, 1 package (17 oz/480 g) prepared beef tips with gravy, ¼ cup (60 ml/2.0 US fl oz) skim milk, 1 can (10.75 oz/305 g) condensed cream of mushroom soup (figures are for fat-free), Salt to taste, Pepper to taste, 1 teaspoon bottled minced garlic, ¼ teaspoon (or more to taste) mild or hot paprika, ½ cup (250 ml/8.5 US fl oz) sour cream (figures are for reduced-fat) and ¼ cup (125 g/4.4 oz) finely-chopped fresh parsley. First, prepare noodles according to package directions and drain. Then, as the noodles are boiling, warm oil in very deep skillet or Dutch oven over medium heat. After that, add mushrooms and onions and cook until onion is soft, about 3 minutes. Next, add beef tips, milk, and mushroom soup. Then, add salt and pepper to taste and stir well. After that, reduce heat to simmer and stir in garlic, paprika, and sour cream. Next, simmer lightly, without letting it boil (that will curdle it). Then, when noodles are finished and drained, serve with noodles on serving plate or individual plates, with sauce over it. Finally, garnish with parsley. And that's it.

First, blend the corn to a paste. Then, blend the crayfish, prawns, peppers, and onion together. Mix in the corn paste. After that, add smoked mackerel and vegetable oil. Season with stock cube and salt. Next, pour the mixture into prepared moi-moi leaves or other desired cooking mold. Finally, steam the filled moi-moi until cooked. And that's it.

Set aside. Next, boil the meat in a pot of water with onions and spices. Remove the meat and set aside. Finally, heat a small amount of palm oil in a pot. Add the blended beans, crayfish, salt, boiled meat, and dryfish. Cook until the fish is softened. And that's it.

cases.title: Accra Cassava (Cameroonian Cassava Fritters)
cases.transcript: Okay, so today I'm making Accra Cassava (Cameroonian Cassava Fritters). For this you need 3 pounds grated cassava (can be frozen and thawed), 4 large, overly ripe bananas (optional), 1 teaspoon or more of salt and A good amount of vegetable oil. First, squeeze the grated cassava using a kitchen cloth or cheesecloth (like the one used for preparing homemade pap) to remove as much liquid as possible. The cassava should be very dry with little liquid. Then, mash the bananas well using a fork, masher, or food processor. After that, add the cassava and salt to the mashed banana in a medium sized bowl, and mix them together very well. The mixture should be firm enough that it can be rolled into balls. Next, use your palms to roll about 2 tablespoons of the mixture into bite-size balls. Then, heat the vegetable oil to 375 °F in a deep skillet or a saucepan. You can check the oil temperature by dropping in a 1-inch square of bread—it should take about 1 minute to brown. After that, place the cassava balls gently into the hot oil and fry until golden brown. Do not overcrowd the pan—work in batches as necessary. Finally, remove the fritters from the hot oil, drain, and serve fresh. And that's it.

First, pick any dirt or debris out of the pigeon peas, then wash them and soak in water overnight. Then, drain away the soaking water. And that's it.

Arrange the tofu slices on it. Sprinkle more starch over the tofu. Then, heat the oil to 355°F (180°C) for deep frying. After that, pat any excess starch off the tofu slices and slide them into the hot oil, one by one. Don't add too many slices at once, because the tofu lowers the oil temperature. Fry until golden, turning once. Next, remove and drain on paper towels. Finally, arrange the tofu in a dish, and pour the sauce over top.
